diagnosis: Original regression calls Path.touch() immediately after building/reading a tiny fixture. touch can leave the recorded mtime/ctime fingerprint unchanged; it never changes payload bytes. The assertion unconditionally expects FAIL_CUSTODY even when nothing in the validated fingerprint or content changed. Explicitly distinct mtime, appended content, and inode replacement are separate deterministic controls.
limits: Only disposable CPU fixtures were changed. Real archives, seals, Main log, original code and prior receipts were not written.
Stat/digest checks are not an atomic snapshot or a proof against a writer after verification. This diagnostic does not claim arbitrary concurrent mutation can be prevented.
Test-only versioning is appropriate if changed-fingerprint controls all reject; no runtime detector change is inferred from a same-stat touch alone.
